description: This file defines the ConfigResolver class, which provides static methods for loading and merging configuration files that return arrays, and for checking file existence and readability.

classes.name: ConfigResolver
classes.description: Provides static methods to load configuration files and verify their existence and readability.

methods.name: loadFiles
methods.description: Loads multiple configuration files, merging their array contents into a single array.

methods.name: isFileExist
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and is readable; throws an exception if not.
